entries.reason: R1 — finalize-cleanup envelope mode still writes only JSON to stdout, and ok:true envelopes with data.report.text emit a Finalize Report block containing the raw report text via stderr/writeErr in the same dispatch.; R2 — cleanup displays envelope data.report.text verbatim after the Finalize Report header, and spec-local coverage compares that displayed text exactly against flow report show output.; R3 — Dispatcher emits a non-stdout REPORT_MISSING warning instead of a Report block when ok finalize-cleanup returns data.report null with the warning; added spec test asserts ok:true, data.report:null, REPORT_MISSING, visible warning, and no Finalize Report block.; R4 — Diff relocates finalize-cleanup agentWorkDir, explicit --log-file runtime logs, and config.logs.dir via FinalizeCleanupPathResolver when running from a worktree, resolving inside-worktree paths under mainRoot before logger/runtime log creation.; R5 — Diff relocates finalize-cleanup agent work, explicit log file, and config log dirs out of deleted worktrees before writes; tests assert no log write failed or deleted-worktree ENOENT warnings for those cases.; R6 — Diff updates finalize-cleanup prompt, skill template via included partial, and both generated installed skill copies to state cleanup displays the Report itself and `sdd-forge flow report show` can re-display it.; R7 — Spec-local tests were added under specs/261-finalize-report-delivery/tests with // spec headers covering R1-R5, and include a fixture passing --agent-work-dir under a worktree that cleanup deletes.; Spec Test Coverage — The diff adds spec-local tests under specs/261-finalize-report-delivery/tests/, and each added spec test file has a // spec: R<N> header covering the listed requirements.; Avoid Overengineering — new single-use include partial: src/templates/partials/finalize-cleanup-report-delivery.md — The diff introduces a new template partial that is only included once in the provided diff. That is a single-caller indirection layer, which the guardrail forbids. (at src/templates/partials/finalize-cleanup-report-delivery.md:1); Avoid Overengineering — duplicate stream write capture helper: captureProcessStdout — This added helper duplicates the same capture-and-restore stream write shape as the stderr capture helper in another added spec test file. The guardrail requires extracting a helper when the same code shape appears in two or more places. (at specs/261-finalize-report-delivery/tests/finalize-cleanup-display.test.js:60); Avoid Overengineering — duplicate stream write capture helper: captureProcessStderr — This added helper duplicates the same capture-and-restore stream write shape as the stdout capture helper in another added spec test file. The guardrail requires extracting a helper when the same code shape appears in two or more places. (at specs/261-finalize-report-delivery/tests/finalize-cleanup-log-paths.test.js:79)

entries.resolution: removed the single-use finalize-cleanup partial by inlining the guidance and extracted duplicated process stream capture helpers into specs/261-finalize-report-delivery/tests/helpers/process-stream.js
